description: This file defines a utility function named 'shapeAgentGroupedSeries' that processes an array of record objects related to costs, grouping and formatting them for visualization with Recharts. The function aggregates total costs by agent and category, filling missing categories with a placeholder, and supports sorting options.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries(records, groupBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms raw aggregate records into a grouped dataset suitable for Recharts, organizing data by agent and category with optional sorting and label customization.
